_comment: SSOT for the canonical trovex quickstart (audit 2026-10-13 TR-03). The landing imports it; README.md, docs/quickstart.md and the static /for/* pages are checked against it by scripts/check-quickstart.mjs in `npm run build`. Commands mirror src/trovex/cli.py (index/search/serve/setup) and pyproject [project.scripts]. Change a command HERE first, then fix the pages the check names.
search: trovex search "how do we roll back a deploy?"
claudeCode: claude mcp add --transport http trovex http://localhost:8765/mcp
trySearch: uvx trovex search "how do we roll back a deploy?"
